prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_CWT_rf', seasonality_champion='FT_rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: ONLY_CWT_rf dominates with perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (36.66), while FT_rf captures seasonality best (0.94 correlation). High model disagreement (RMSE spread 82.91) and distinct early/late specialists (ONLY_CWT_catboost vs DWT_catboost) suggest STL-hierarchical stacking with mixed weighting to exploit decomposition strengths across trend and seasonal components.
